headline: Unbeaten Dallas Baptist meet Texas Woman's again
dek: Dallas Baptist have won eighteen and drawn two, scoring 65 goals across all their matches and conceding nine; none of the other fourteen programmes has scored as many. One of those draws came against Texas Woman's, the side they meet next.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: One programme scores at a different rate from the rest: Dallas Baptist have more goals than Angelo State, UT Permian Basin, Texas A&M International, Sul Ross State and Eastern New Mexico together.

wire.line: Texas Woman's have conceded three goals in all their matches this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches dated in August still carry no published result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sixteen different players have scored for Dallas Baptist.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ashley Washburn has eighteen assists for Dallas Baptist.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Helen Lazaro has scored fourteen goals for St. Mary's as a freshman.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kat Graves has made 105 saves for Sul Ross State, a save percentage of .808.

last_match.line: Dallas Baptist had already won at UCCS in September, and are yet to lose this season.

next_match.line: Texas Woman's only defeat this season came at Midwestern State.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
